source: K20 Sub-Family RM, FTMx_FILTER register note
note: Canonical entry = FTM0 FILTER gated by FTM0_QDCTRL.QUADEN cleared (channels not quadrature inputs); the same hazard applies to the other FTM instances. Surfaced as survey bug #4: mk20dx-hal set_filter (pwm.rs:1859) writes FILTER while QUADEN=1.

constraint.consequence: Writing FILTER while channels 0/1 are active quadrature inputs can cause a valid signal to be missed.
constraint.datasheet_text: Writing to the FILTER register has immediate effect and must be done only when the channels 0, 1, 2, and 3 are not in input modes. Failure to do this could result in a missing valid signal.
